Send toot

Source: R/mastodon.R
llrs_toots.Rd

Split and merge the text as needed to reduce the number of toots to post. It only handles text and not images as per rtoot::post_thread()

Usage

llrs_toots(msg, width = 500, join_text = ". ")

Arguments

msg

A vector of strings if possible they will be joined

width

Allowed width on the server

join_text

Character used to join the text

Value

The ids of the toots posted
